tools.name: listAllApplications
tools.description: Retrieve a list of subscriptions and applications you have access to. Often used as a first step with other tools (for example, passing App IDs to aggregateEntityUsage for usage data). Also confirms which application data you have access to through authentication.

tools.name: searchEntities
tools.description: Find Pendo items by name or conceptual meaning, including Pages, Features, Track Events, accounts, and saved clips. (Deprecated for guides and product areas).

tools.name: segmentList
tools.description: List all publicly shared segments with their names and IDs.

tools.name: getEntity
tools.description: Retrieve the full configuration of a single Page, Feature, Track Event, or guide by its exact ID. Returns URL rules for Pages, element rules and Page context for Features, event rules for Track Events, and ordered steps, polls, and interactive elements for guides. Doesn't return usage metrics.

tools.name: listCustomObjects
tools.description: List the custom event properties designated as business objects. Returns each object's underlying field and kind, customer-facing display name and description when configured, and the date it was promoted to an object.

tools.name: getSegment
tools.description: Retrieve the full definition and details for a single saved segment by ID.

tools.name: createSegment
tools.description: Create a new saved segment in Pendo.

tools.name: updateSegment
tools.description: Update an existing saved segment's definition or name.

tools.name: deleteSegment
tools.description: Delete a saved segment by ID.

tools.name: accountMetadataSchema
tools.description: View the available metadata fields for accounts, such as ARR, industry, renewal date, or product tier. Returns field names, types (for example, boolean or string), and a historical flag indicating whether the field supports historical (event-time) filtering.

tools.name: visitorMetadataSchema
tools.description: View the available metadata fields for visitors, such as job title, CRM fields, region, or role. Returns field names, types (for example, boolean or string), and a historical flag indicating whether the field supports historical (event-time) filtering.

tools.name: listAccounts
tools.description: List or search accounts. You can list accounts matching an inline or saved segment, or search for accounts without providing an App ID.

tools.name: listVisitors
tools.description: List visitors matching an inline or saved segment.

tools.name: buildPendoSegment
tools.description: Build an inline AND/OR segment definition from visitor or account metadata, product usage (Pages, Features, Track Events), guide interactions, or existing segment membership, for use as an input to other tools.

tools.name: visitorActivity
tools.description: Return a chronological activity timeline for one visitor, with available developer console and network logs interleaved with product activity.

tools.name: productAreaMemberActivity
tools.description: Return all Pages, Features, and Track Events belonging to a product area, including those with zero activity in the date range.

tools.name: listProductAreas
tools.description: List all product areas for a subscription, including their IDs, names, and descriptions. Supports optional fuzzy search and pagination.

tools.name: listCountables
tools.description: List or search Pages, Features, and Track Events. For Features, you can provide a Page ID to restrict results to Features associated with that Page.

tools.name: entityUsage
tools.description: Retrieve usage metrics for a single Page, Feature, or Track Event, broken down by visitor or account. You can also request visitor or account metadata fields to include with each result row.

tools.name: entityUsageTimeSeries
tools.description: Retrieve usage metrics for a single Page, Feature, or Track Event, bucketed by day, week, or month. Use the optional minEvents input to count only visitors who generated at least that many events on the entity within each bucket.

tools.name: eventPropertyAnalytics
tools.description: Analyze the values of an event property for a Page, Feature, or Track Event as a breakdown or time series, with optional grouping and filtering.

tools.name: aggregateEntityUsage
tools.description: Rank all Pages, Features, or Track Events of a given type by usage.

tools.name: appUsage
tools.description: Retrieve app-level usage metrics, broken down by visitor or account. Optionally return requested visitor or account metadata fields with each row.

tools.name: appUsageTimeSeries
tools.description: Retrieve app-level usage metrics over time, bucketed by day, week, or month. Use the optional minEvents input to count only visitors who generated at least that many events within each bucket.

tools.name: productEngagementScore
tools.description: View product health using Pendo's Product Engagement Score (PES) for adoption, stickiness, and growth. Supports custom configurations for user base, stickiness calculations, and event filters.

tools.name: queryFunnel
tools.description: Calculate an ordered two- or three-step funnel for visitors or objects. Funnel steps can use Pages, Features, and Track Events.

tools.name: acquisitionTrend
tools.description: Measure first-time visitors or accounts by period.

tools.name: cohortRetentionCurve
tools.description: Build a retention curve for an app, Page, Feature, Track Event, or product area.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsKeyMetrics
tools.description: Retrieve key aggregate metrics for an AI agent's conversations, including prompt volume, visitor and account counts, rage prompt rates, and retention.

tools.name: listAiAgents
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all AI agents you have access to. Often used as the first step to get Agent IDs for use with other Agent Analytics tools.

tools.name: listUseCases
tools.description: Retrieve conversation clustering analysis for an AI agent, grouping prompts and conversations by semantic topic.

tools.name: listAiAgentIssues
tools.description: Retrieve detected issues in AI agent conversations.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsIssueAnalysis
tools.description: Retrieve issue diagnoses, flagged response tool and model usage, and visitor prompt content for the events of a specific detected issue cluster.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsUseCaseAnalysis
tools.description: Perform a detailed analysis of one emergent (automatically clustered) use case identified by listUseCases.

tools.name: listTrackedIssues
tools.description: List user-defined tracked issues for an AI agent.

tools.name: listTrackedUseCases
tools.description: List user-defined tracked use cases for an AI agent.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsConversationAnalysis
tools.description: Perform a detailed analysis of selected AI agent conversations.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsTrackedIssueAnalysis
tools.description: Perform a detailed analysis of one tracked issue, including sampled visitor prompts and tool or model usage.

tools.name: agentAnalyticsTrackedUseCaseAnalysis
tools.description: Perform a detailed analysis of one tracked use case.

tools.name: commandCenterApps
tools.description: List the Command Center SaaS portfolio, covering both managed and discovered apps, with each app's cost, estimated cost, license count, owner, renewal date, category, AI and shadow-IT signals, admin notes, IT governance status, active-user count, license usage, and potential annual savings from unused licenses.

tools.name: updateCommandCenterApp
tools.description: Update an app's license count, annual cost, renewal date, or notes (individually or several at once) for a single managed or discovered app.

tools.name: resolveBusinessObject
tools.description: Resolve a business object.

tools.name: listBusinessObjectMetadata
tools.description: List business object metadata.

tools.name: objectAnalyticsActiveCount
tools.description: Return active-object metrics for a business object.

tools.name: objectAnalyticsBreakdown
tools.description: Return a breakdown of analytics for a business object.

tools.name: objectAnalyticsTimeSeries
tools.description: Track engagement with a business object over time, grouped into daily, weekly, or monthly buckets. By default, engagement is measured as average time per object.

tools.name: objectEventBreakdown
tools.description: Return object-related event activity breakdowns for a business object.

tools.name: listGuides
tools.description: List, filter, and optionally retrieve full content for in-app guides, including IDs, names, states, types, and scheduling.

tools.name: guidePollResponses
tools.description: Analyze poll responses collected in a guide.

tools.name: guideEffectivenessMetrics
tools.description: Return dashboard-consistent guide engagement, completion, and goal-adoption rates, with filtering and segment comparison.

tools.name: aggregateGuideMetrics
tools.description: Rank guides by views, completions, dismissals, unique visitors, unique accounts, or views per user. You can restrict results by guide IDs, current status, guide type, activation method, product area, guide category, Page, or app.

tools.name: guideUsage
tools.description: Break down usage of a single guide by visitor or account, or inspect each guide step's visitor count and time on step.

tools.name: listGuideCategories
tools.description: Return the guide-category tree for a subscription.

tools.name: listGuideOrdering
tools.description: Return guide display-order rules for an application.

tools.name: guideSetState
tools.description: Change the state of a guide, such as publishing a draft, staging a guide for review, or making an active guide inactive.

tools.name: guideSetSegment
tools.description: Update the audience segment targeting for a guide.

tools.name: listGuideExperiments
tools.description: List A/B experiments configured on guides, including their status and configuration.

tools.name: listSurveys
tools.description: List available surveys, including their names, types, and IDs.

tools.name: surveyScores
tools.description: Return NPS, CSAT, PMF, and UMUX scores by survey and type.

tools.name: surveyResponses
tools.description: Return per-visitor responses for a single survey, including individual answers, response distributions per question, and each visitor's most recent answer.

tools.name: sessionReplayList
tools.description: Returns links to replays for specific visitors or behaviors. Default filters: minimum duration 120 seconds, minimum activity 5%. Exclude list behavior options available. Supports event property filtering.

tools.name: sessionReplaySummarize
tools.description: Summarize session replay data.

tools.name: devlogEvents
tools.description: Retrieve raw development logs for a visitor or session, including HTTP request and response details, log levels, messages, and stack traces so you can see exactly what happened technically during the experience.

tools.name: getFeedbackItems
tools.description: Retrieve raw customer feedback items that match specific filters, including the original title, description, status, and creation date, along with associated account and visitor details.

tools.name: getFeedbackInsights
tools.description: Retrieve extracted feedback insights from customer feedback that match specific filters, including summaries, explanations, and supporting quotes.

tools.name: generateFeedbackTopics
tools.description: Generate AI-clustered topics from customer feedback that matches specific filters, with each topic including a name, description, and count of related insights.

tools.name: getIdeas
tools.description: Retrieve product ideas that match specific filters. Each item includes a title, description, and status.

tools.name: createFeedbackItem
tools.description: Create a new feedback item in Listen.

tools.name: createIdeaItem
tools.description: Create a new idea in Listen.

tools.name: updateIdeaItem
tools.description: Update an existing Listen idea.

tools.name: updateFeedbackItem
tools.description: Update an existing feedback item.

tools.name: linkIdeaAndFeedback
tools.description: Associate an existing idea with an existing feedback item.

tools.name: unlinkIdeaFeedback
tools.description: Remove the association between an idea and a feedback item.

tools.name: listOrchestrateJourneys
tools.description: List Orchestrate journeys in a subscription, optionally filtered by status (draft, review, scheduled, active, paused, completed, or disabled). Use it to find a Journey ID before requesting configuration, steps, or performance.

tools.name: getOrchestrateJourney
tools.description: Retrieve full configuration for a single journey by ID, including audience, goal, scheduling, and email settings.

tools.name: getOrchestrateJourneySteps
tools.description: Retrieve the ordered step graph for a journey, including each step's type (message, condition, or exit), position, and linked email or guide.

tools.name: getOrchestrateJourneyMetrics
tools.description: Retrieve journey-level performance, including visitors entered, visitors completed, and goal attainment for journeys with a goal.

tools.name: listOrchestrateEmails
tools.description: List Orchestrate email campaigns, both standalone and journey-linked (Listen and Sentiment survey emails excluded). Supports optional filters for status, app, or name.

tools.name: getOrchestrateEmail
tools.description: Retrieve full configuration for a single email by ID, including subject, provider, audience, schedule, and (for journey-linked emails) its Journey ID.

tools.name: getOrchestrateEmailMetrics
tools.description: Retrieve performance metrics for a single email, including delivery, unique opens, unique clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, and spam complaints, matching the Orchestrate email overview.

tools.name: getOrchestrateEmailVisitors
tools.description: Retrieve per-visitor email engagement data for an Orchestrate email.

tools.name: listOrchestrateJourneyTemplates
tools.description: List the available journey templates you can use to create new journeys.

tools.name: createOrchestrateJourneyFromTemplate
tools.description: Create a new draft journey in Orchestrate from an existing template.

tools.name: createOrchestrateJourneyFromJson
tools.description: Create a new draft journey in Orchestrate from a full JSON journey definition.

tools.name: setOrchestrateJourneySchedule
tools.description: Set or update the schedule for a journey, including its start and end dates.

tools.name: updateOrchestrateEmailContent
tools.description: Update HTML content for eligible journey email steps.
